questions.stem:
—I _______ my English book yesterday morning. Have you seen it?
—Yes, I _______ it on your desk just now.
questions.explanation: ① 第一空后有yesterday morning（昨天早上），是具体的过去时间状语，只能用一般过去时lost；② 第二空just now表示"刚才"，也是明确的过去时间点，用一般过去时found；③ 现在完成时不能与yesterday, just now等具体过去时间连用。口诀：具体过去用过去，完成时态不接when。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: The boy _______ is playing basketball over there is my class monitor.
questions.explanation: ① 先行词是The boy（人），排除指物的B选项which；② 定语从句中缺少主语（is playing前缺主语），who可作主语，whom只能作宾语，whose表示"谁的"后需接名词；③ 因此选who。技巧：先行词是人，从句缺主语用who，缺宾语用who/whom。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: These old houses _______ by the government next year to make room for new schools.
questions.explanation: ① 主语These old houses（老房子）是"被拆除"的对象，需用被动语态（be+过去分词）；② next year表示将来时间，用一般将来时的被动语态will be+过去分词；③ pull down是动词短语，被动语态中要保持完整。干扰项A是主动语态，C是现在进行时的主动，D是一般过去时。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem:
—Have you ever visited the Science Museum?
—Yes. I _______ there twice with my classmates last month.
questions.explanation: ① 虽然问句用现在完成时，但答句中有last month（上个月）这一具体过去时间状语，必须用一般过去时；② have been to表示"去过某地（已回）"，但不可与last month连用；③ went是go的过去式，符合一般过去时+具体过去时间的要求。这是易错点：不要看到问句用完成时就盲目用完成时回答。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: As a volunteer, I often _______ the elderly at the nursing home on weekends.
questions.explanation: ① look after表示"照顾"，符合句意"在养老院照顾老人"；② look for寻找，look up查阅（词典），look at看着；③ 固定搭配题需积累常见动词短语。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.stem: The _______ news made all the students _______ . They jumped with joy.
questions.explanation: ① exciting（令人兴奋的）修饰事物news，excited（感到兴奋的）修饰人students；② 口诀：-ing修饰物，-ed修饰人；③ 句意：这个令人兴奋的消息让所有学生感到兴奋。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.stem: The heavy rain caused serious _______ in the low-lying areas. Many houses were underwater.
questions.explanation: ① 根据上下文语境：heavy rain（大雨）、underwater（在水下）提示是"洪水"；② flood洪水，drought干旱，earthquake地震，fire火灾；③ 词义猜测题需抓住上下文关键词（rain, underwater）进行逻辑推理。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.explanation: ① 固定搭配do a project（做项目）；② make制造，create创造，produce生产，均不与project构成最佳搭配；③ 完形填空中要注意动词与名词的固定搭配。
questions.label: 完形填空
questions.group_passage:
Our school has started a new program called "Green Campus" this semester. The aim is to make our school more environmentally friendly. Last month, our class was asked to (8)______ a special project about waste sorting.

At first, many students thought it was (9)______ and didn't want to take part. However, after our teacher explained the importance of protecting the environment, we changed our minds. We (10)______ posters and put them up around the school to remind everyone to sort their rubbish.

During the first week, things were not easy. Some students still threw everything into the same bin. But we didn't (11)______. We stood near the bins during break time and helped our classmates sort the waste correctly. Slowly, more and more students started to (12)______ the rules.

Now, after a month, our school has produced 30% less waste than before. Everyone feels proud of what we have achieved.

questions.explanation: ① 根据下文"didn't want to take part（不想参加）"可知学生们一开始觉得"无聊/枯燥"；② boring无聊的，interesting有趣的（与语境相反），important重要的，necessary必要的；③ 完形填空要注意上下文逻辑关系（不想参加→觉得无聊）。

questions.stem: What happens when sea turtles eat plastic bags?
options: A. They feel sick immediately and die.
B. They stop eating real food.
C. They become more active in the ocean.
D. They return to the beach for help.
questions.explanation: ① 细节理解题，定位原文第二段："the plastic stays in their stomachs and makes them feel full, so they stop eating real food"；② 塑料让海龟感到饱胀，因此停止进食真正的食物；③ A项"立即死亡"与原文不符（原文说many turtles die，但不是immediately），C、D项文中未提及。
questions.label: 阅读-细节理解
questions.group_passage:
Every year, more than 8 million tons of plastic waste ends up in our oceans. This is a serious problem that affects not only sea animals but also human health.

Sea turtles often mistake plastic bags for jellyfish (水母), which is their favorite food. When they eat these bags, the plastic stays in their stomachs and makes them feel full, so they stop eating real food. Sadly, many turtles die because of this.

Scientists have also found microplastics (微塑料) in the deepest parts of the ocean. These tiny pieces of plastic come from larger items that break down over time. Fish can absorb these microplastics, and when humans eat these fish, the plastics enter our bodies too.

To solve this problem, many countries have banned (禁止) single-use plastics like straws and plastic bags. Some scientists are working on new materials that can break down naturally in the environment. However, the most important solution is to reduce how much plastic we use in our daily lives.

"We can't wait for others to fix this," says marine biologist Dr. Li. "Everyone needs to take action now, or our oceans will be in great danger."

questions.stem: What does the underlined word "banned" in Paragraph 4 probably mean?
questions.explanation: ① 词义猜测题，根据上下文：为了解决污染问题，各国对一次性塑料（如吸管、塑料袋）采取了banned措施；② 后文说"最重要的是减少使用"，可推测banned是"禁止"之意；③ stopped by law（法律禁止）符合语境，allowed to use（允许使用）与语境相反，produced（生产）和sold（销售）不符。

Many middle school students feel stressed because they have too much homework and too many after-school classes. (17)______ Here are some useful tips to help you manage your time better.

First, make a to-do list every morning. Write down all the things you need to do and put them in order of importance. (18)______ This way, you won't forget important tasks.

Second, find your most productive time. Some students work best in the morning, while others focus better at night. (19)______ Don't waste your best hours on unimportant things like playing mobile games.

Finally, remember to take breaks. Studying for hours without rest actually makes you less efficient. (20)______ You'll return to your studies with a clearer mind.

options: A. However, with good time management, you can handle everything better.
B. For example, you can take a 10-minute walk or listen to music.
C. Try to do the most difficult tasks when your energy is highest.
D. This helps you stay organized and focused throughout the day.
E. On the other hand, some students prefer to study with friends.
questions.explanation: ① 前文讲"列待办清单，按重要性排序"，后文"这样你就不会忘记重要任务"，中间需要解释列清单的好处；② D项"这帮助你全天保持有条理和专注"中This指代前文的make a to-do list；③ This/That/These/Those通常是解题线索，指代前文内容。
